lines.zh: 我一边走一边转，四处都对着。
lines.en: I walk and turn, facing every direction.

lines.zh: 我的身子朝外张开，像一朵坏掉的花。
lines.en: My body opens outward like a broken flower.
There are impact marks where I have passed.
I shift two steps and lift an arm.

lines.zh: 我绕着圈走，不朝一个方向。
lines.en: I walk in circles, facing no single way.
I scrape along the wall, leaving gouges.

lines.zh: 我每走一步都停下看看。
lines.en: I stop to look with every step.

lines.zh: 我从这片地中间穿过去。
lines.en: I pass through the middle of this ground.

lines.zh: 我拖着影子，影子有四道。
lines.en: I drag four shadows behind me.

lines.zh: 我朝你走，却不看你的方向。
lines.en: I walk at you while facing elsewhere.

lines.zh: 我的步子很稳，像在瞄准。
lines.en: My steps are steady, as if taking aim.

lines.zh: 我停下来，又朝另一边转。
lines.en: I stop and turn the other way.
I stand, spread to all four sides.
My arms rise slowly to level.
I turn in place, looking for angles.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸声像气流喷出。
lines.en: My breathing sounds like escaping gas.

lines.zh: 我不看任何一边，也都看着。
lines.en: I look nowhere and everywhere.

lines.zh: 我的关节一节一节地转。
lines.en: My joints rotate one section at a time.

lines.zh: 四面八方都是我射出的东西。
lines.en: My shots come from every direction.

lines.zh: 我静下来，四周的压力更大了。
lines.en: When I go still, the air feels heavier.

lines.zh: 我的头部没有固定的朝向。
lines.en: My head has no fixed facing.
I draw my arms in a little.

lines.zh: 我在数身边有多少个方向。
lines.en: I count how many directions surround me.
I twitch, like something being loaded.

lines.zh: 我的四周开始有细微的响动。
lines.en: Small sounds begin all around me.
Spread four ways, I wait for you to choose.
You cannot dodge all four sides either.

lines.zh: 我朝向你，也朝别的方向。
lines.en: I face you, and elsewhere at once.

lines.zh: 我的目光不在一个点上。
lines.en: My gaze rests on no single point.

lines.zh: 你站在哪个方向都没用。
lines.en: No direction you choose will help.

lines.zh: 我张开的时候，就是信号。
lines.en: When I open, that is the signal.
Do you hear that whistling?

lines.zh: 我不瞄准，我只是到处都打。
lines.en: I do not aim; I simply strike everywhere.

lines.zh: 你的影子在我眼里有四个。
lines.en: I see four of your shadow.
I turn slowly toward you, and away.
Your shield cannot cover it all.
I will open at you, sooner or later.

lines.zh: 我离你不远，就在这几格。
lines.en: I am close, only these few blocks.

lines.zh: 你身后也有我的一部分。
lines.en: Part of me is behind you too.
I know where you are dodging.
I have no front, only directions.

lines.zh: 我不着急，我等你走错一步。
lines.en: I am in no hurry; I wait for one wrong step.
When I move, the air changes.

lines.zh: 你的耳朵能听出几个方向？
lines.en: How many directions can your ears pick out?

lines.zh: 我不需要追，我只要站着。
lines.en: I need not chase; I only need to stand.
The closer you come, the harder it is to dodge.
One side of me warps and turns back.
You cut me and I give half a step.

lines.zh: 这一下打掉了我一边的响。
lines.en: That silenced one side of me.
I twitch and realign.
Half of me skewed, still turning.
I do not cry out; I only turn faster.

lines.zh: 你打中一个方向，还有三个。
lines.en: You hit one direction; three remain.

lines.zh: 我向后退了一步，又张开。
lines.en: I step back once and open again.
This wound is nothing.

lines.zh: 我歪着身子，重新数方向。
lines.en: Crooked, I recount the directions.
You raise your shield; I like that more.
You retreat to the wall, exactly as I wish.
You stand in the light, very clear.

lines.zh: 你的同伴也在附近，很好。
lines.en: Your companions are nearby; excellent.
That torch in your hand is too bright.

lines.zh: 你朝我走一步，省我的事。
lines.en: One step toward me saves me trouble.

lines.zh: 你想绕后，我后面也有东西。
lines.en: You want to flank me; there is something behind me too.
Your footsteps are very dense.
You retreat into that corridor, which is narrow.
You stand in the open; good target.
We collide and you are thrown back.
My arm scrapes you, and it is hard.

lines.zh: 我被你撞得一歪，立刻又张开。
lines.en: You knock me crooked, and I open again at once.

lines.zh: 你撞在我身上，听到骨响。
lines.en: You hit me and hear bone crack.
All sides of me close in together.
You are spun a full turn.
When we touch, the air cracks.

lines.zh: 我挡开你的手，退了一步。
lines.en: I knock your hand aside and step back.
You pull back with a tear in your clothes.

lines.zh: 我撞得不重，可方向很怪。
lines.en: My blow is light, but the angle is strange.

lines.zh: 我朝四面八方，没有朝向。
lines.en: I face all ways and no way.
This thing needs no other.
I only scatter things.
Asking that, you are standing in the wrong place.

lines.zh: 我的注意力在四条线上。
lines.en: My attention is on four lines.
I turn slowly away without answering.
I open and close like breathing.
That is not what I do.
You would do well not to stand in the centre.

lines.zh: 我在等别的东西，不是你。
lines.en: I am waiting for something else, not you.
I snatch it up and fling it outward.

lines.zh: 我把它丢到很远的地方。
lines.en: I throw it very far away.

lines.zh: 我碰到的东西，都会散开。
lines.en: Whatever I touch scatters.
I pick it up and weigh it.
I drop it and stand on it.

lines.zh: 我一手抓，另一手也伸了过去。
lines.en: I grab with one hand, and another reaches too.
I pick it up, then let go.
This is too light to bother with.
I sweep it over toward you.

lines.zh: 地上有东西，我用臂拨开。
lines.en: I use an arm to sweep aside what lies there.
All four lines now point at you.
I choose you as the centre.

lines.zh: 你站在我能打到的位置。
lines.en: You stand where I can reach.

lines.zh: 我张开了一圈，锁住中间。
lines.en: I open in a ring and lock the middle.
Target confirmed, four directions.

lines.zh: 我朝你可以躲的每一边都摆好。
lines.en: I line up every side you might dodge to.
I hold still and wait for you to enter the ring.
You are already inside the ring.
I hear where your heartbeat is.
I need not chase; I only need to release.
Turn as you like; you will find no gap.
I tighten the range slowly.

lines.zh: 你成了这一圈的中心点。
lines.en: You have become this circle's centre.

lines.zh: 我锁住你，连你的影子一起。
lines.en: I lock you, shadow and all.
Whichever way you go, I have something there.

lines.zh: 这个距离，我可以开火了。
lines.en: At this range, I can fire.
I keep adjusting the angle.
You go left, and this side turns too.

lines.zh: 我不停地转，找你的缺口。
lines.en: I keep turning, seeking a gap in you.

lines.zh: 你听得到那种压力的声音。
lines.en: You can hear the pressure building.

lines.zh: 我每一面都对着你的一侧。
lines.en: Each of my sides faces one of yours.
I am not hasty; I wait for you to settle.

lines.zh: 你退到角落，我就占满角落。
lines.en: You retreat to the corner, and I fill it.
My noise grows denser.
Your shield covers front; I come from above.

lines.zh: 我一直在你周围，不离开。
lines.en: I stay around you and do not leave.

lines.zh: 你已经没有正后方的说法了。
lines.en: You no longer have a safe back.
One move of your hand and all sides rattle.
My range keeps shrinking.

lines.zh: 你听见四声，其实是同一个。
lines.en: You hear four sounds; they are one.
I line up slowly and steadily.
No need to run; it changes nothing.
I squeeze the air until it sings.

lines.zh: 你身边每一侧都热了起来。
lines.en: Every side of you grows warm.

lines.zh: 我在等你往一个方向偏。
lines.en: I wait for you to lean one way.

lines.zh: 这一圈，最后收到你身上。
lines.en: This circle closes on you in the end.
Four directions hit you at once.
I strike down from the side, fast.

lines.zh: 这一下你分不清从哪来。
lines.en: You cannot tell where that came from.
My arm lands on your back.
You are shoved into a half turn.

lines.zh: 我打的时候，别的方向也在动。
lines.en: As I strike, the other sides move too.

lines.zh: 这一下带着骨头的重量。
lines.en: There is bone weight in that blow.

lines.zh: 你挡了一边，漏了另一边。
lines.en: You block one side and miss another.
I grab you and pull inward.

lines.zh: 你倒下的位置，正好在中间。
lines.en: You fall exactly in the centre.

lines.zh: 我拍在你腿上，膝盖一软。
lines.en: I strike your leg and your knee gives.

lines.zh: 四面八方都有东西过来。
lines.en: Something comes from every direction.
I close slowly and clamp you.
You retreat two steps and I open wider.

lines.zh: 我打的地方会留下一个圈。
lines.en: Where I strike, a ring remains.
That was only to stop you.
I take a little of each corner first.
The air shivers first.
I appear right in the middle of you.

lines.zh: 你听到四面八方都有声。
lines.en: You hear sound from every direction.
Dust on the ground lifts up.
I push outward from the wall.
I unfold layer by layer, slowly.

lines.zh: 你先感到压迫，再看到我。
lines.en: You feel the pressure before you see me.

lines.zh: 我落地，四个影子同时张开。
lines.en: I land and four shadows spread at once.

lines.zh: 角落里有东西立起来了。
lines.en: Something rises in the corner.
The moment I appear, the way narrows.
My noise comes from four sides.

lines.zh: 我从暗处伸出一段，又一段。
lines.en: I extend out of the dark, part by part.

lines.zh: 你四周的距离同时变短。
lines.en: Every distance around you shortens at once.
My shape defies sense.

lines.zh: 我站在中间，四面都朝外。
lines.en: I stand in the middle, all sides outward.

lines.zh: 你听见骨头转动的声音。
lines.en: You hear bones rotating.
The moment I appear, the wind goes wrong.
I have made this place a ring.
I spread forward from behind you.

lines.zh: 火从一侧烧来，我转开了。
lines.en: Fire comes from one side and I turn away.

lines.zh: 我从上面被砸下，摊开在地。
lines.en: Something smashes me down and I flatten out.

lines.zh: 水一闷，我的声音变低了。
lines.en: Under water my sound drops low.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我四面都掀开了。
lines.en: The blast blows all my sides open.

lines.zh: 箭从一边进来，我另一面也疼。
lines.en: An arrow enters one side and another aches too.

lines.zh: 法术困住我，我转不动了。
lines.en: Magic traps me and I cannot turn.

lines.zh: 很久没打到东西，我慢下来了。
lines.en: Nothing hit for a long while, and I slow down.

lines.zh: 雷从上面劈下，我四个影子都亮了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes from above and all four shadows glow.

lines.zh: 虚空吸我，我四面都朝里塌。
lines.en: The void pulls and all sides collapse inward.
